segments.combination: One 28-year-old reviewer with combination skin, who had struggled with hormonal and regular acne her whole life despite trying many other regimens, reports her skin improved drastically within two weeks of adding this gel to her nightly routine.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, picky and reactive, or sensitive and acne-prone consistently report a brief tingling sensation on application but no lasting irritation, redness, or breakouts, with some also noting improvements in fine lines and blackheads.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin, including one in her 60s with age spots and one in her mid-40s, report dewy, brighter skin and a sense of slowed visible aging, with one continuing to use other mature-skin lines from the same brand.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, including one who saw about a 50% reduction on her forehead, and another in her mid-40s who feels the treatment has slowed visible signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Reports are mixed: some reviewers find it can be drying and recommend following with a moisturizer, while others describe it as hydrating and report no dryness at all.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report only a brief tingling on application with no lasting redness, including some who specifically note their skin does not turn red or get irritated.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report the gel is too strong for parts of their skin: one experiences painful, visible burns on her neck lasting a couple of days each time she uses it even though her face tolerates it fine, and another with skin of color reports burns and new hyperpigmentation from the 10% strength, recommending Naturium's gentler 8% version instead.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report fading dark spots, scars, and a more even, brighter tone within one to several weeks; however, one reviewer with skin of color reports the 10% strength burned her skin and caused new, deep hyperpigmentation she is still working to resolve.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with long-standing hormonal or cystic acne, report a significant reduction in breakouts and acne scarring over two to several weeks; however, a few reviewers report the opposite: a new whitehead breakout the morning after use, repeated breakouts each time they use it, or no change in their blemishes after a couple of weeks.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable tingling reassures it is working
Can intensify into real stinging or burning for some
Rich gel texture preferred over liquid glycolic toners
Priced well below comparable glycolic acid products

extraits.texte: I love glycolic acid, but please be careful as 10% can be highly sensitizing–specifically for skin of color individuals– as it can burn your skin and deep hyperpigmentation can appear. I returned mine and opted for Naturium's 8% glycolic acid, and I personally think the percentage makes all the difference. As a brown person, I'm still trying to figure out how to get ride of my burns because of the 10%, so be aware!!

extraits.titre: Buyer Beware. This is a strong gel.
extraits.texte: I want to love this gel so much, but every time I use it, while my l my face comes out mostly fine, my neck gets crazy, painful burns. The sting is noticably more intense on my neck when I apply it (only once a week), and the next day it looks like I've been strangled. The burns lasts for a couple of days after. I've tried this three times with the same results.

For me, the resurfacing gel works wonderfully. Using it every other night on trouble spots has been very helpful. It has only been a couple of weeks but I love it! It helps to shrink my blemishes quickly. It can be drying so using a moisturizer, as suggested, is a great idea. A little goes a long way so use sparingly. I'm glad that I tried this product. It is a great addition to my routine and I will continue to use occasionally when I'm experiencing breakouts.

extraits.titre: Only thing that has truly made a difference!
extraits.texte: I am 28 y/o, have combination skin and have been battling with hormonal and regular acne my whole life. I have tried numerous products and regiments, changed my diet, exercise and sleeping habits, and nothing worked. But then I bought this product and OMG, my skin improved drastically in a matter of 2 weeks. I use it in the PM portion of my regiment, which is the following: BHA cleansing oil Krave gel cleanser Glycolic Acid gel (this product) Cerave Skin Renewing night cream I also changed my AM moisturizer with the niacinamide gel cream, which I'm sure has contributed to the improvement of my skin as well. So happy with these products, can't wait to try more! Thanks Susan Yara!!!!

I have sensitive skin and well my skin had been balanced more than usual lately, but I was wondering should I risk my balanced skin trying something like glycolic acid? Well I did it and I must say my fine lines on my forehead have reduced by about 50% mine and my blackheads on my chin (most likely from mask) have almost disappeared! I tried BHA 2% and it did an ok job got rid of the darkest ones and prevented new one but mostly keep it stable but I've only used this 3 times and my blackheads are 90% gone! I've never had blackheads in this area so it was new territory for me but this helped so much! And my skin can tolerate it, I used it twice one week and once last week. I'm nervous to use it more than that but really happy with my purchase!

This product has really improved my skin. I apply it before my serum and moisturizer and they all work well together. I had acne when younger and now have age spots at age 68. I wear less makeup since using these products. So happy I gave this brand a try!

I haven't used glycolic acid in a few months because I was getting maskne. So I wanted to stay away from actives for a little bit until my skin started to calm down. I was left with PIH and since I incorporated other ingredients into my skincare to reduce the inflammation, I thought I would give this another go. I forgot how much this can sting, however after 2 - 3 weeks, my skin has adjusted to it. I only use this 2-3 times a week which is more than enough for me. I do see a difference in my acne scars. They're finally fading away.
